channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Anthropic, Nvidia shares rise in premarket trading after major tech selloff
item.description: The Nasdaq slid 10% last week in its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020.

item.title: CrowdStrike bets on network security with $43.9 billion Zscaler deal
item.description: CrowdStrike said on ⁠Monday it would buy Zscaler in an ​all-stock deal ​that values ​the company at about $43.9 billion.

item.title: Zelenskyy praises ‘exemplary’ drone operation that sank Russian warship in a Libyan port
item.description: The incident comes alongside a suspected Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea over the weekend.

item.title: U.S. probes Megaspeed, Alice Huang as new figure emerges in Nvidia chip case
item.description: The U.S. is investigating Megaspeed and Alice Huang after it emerged a former associate of hers was reportedly "deeply involved" in the firm's activities

item.title: As prediction markets grow, so do the number of short sellers counting on DraftKings to fall
item.description: S3 estimates DraftKings short interest rose 17% since the NFL season began as prediction market volumes continue to march higher.

item.title: Stuck: How a frozen housing market is hitting buyers, sellers and the economy
item.description: A sharp spike in mortgage rates in September has pushed the already chilly real estate sector into a deep freeze.

item.title: The Nasdaq is in freefall. Here's one stock to look at
item.description: Elevated options premiums are creating an opportunity in Amazon

item.title: Treasury yields jump as stock futures rebound, investors await New York Fed President Williams speech
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields rose Monday, partially unwinding price action seen at the end of last week, as stock futures pointed to a strong rebound on Wall Street.

item.title: ‘Worst COP ever’: Climate talks collapse after draft deal fails to include fossil fuels
item.description: Governments and campaigners rejected the "cover decision" drafted at the U.N.'s climate summit, COP31, on Sunday.

item.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
item.description: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.

item.title: Social Security benefits are rising in 2027, but other changes could affect what you keep
item.description: A 3.6% Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 will increase benefits across the board. But Medicare and tax changes will also affect retirees.

item.title: Pizza chains are under pressure. GLP-1 use is only one part of the problem
item.description: Domino's, Papa Johns and Pizza Hut face weaker demand, more delivery competition and changing eating habits, including GLP-1 use.

item.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens
item.description: Foundation is pursuing an emergency bridge loan and has been in talks with VC firms as it waits for a $150 million investment from South Korea's Base Group.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attacks on Saudi oil refinery as Trump warns of new strikes next year
item.description: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis claimed an operation against Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery, as diplomatic efforts to end the war face long odds.

item.title: Investors gives a thumbs down to Tata Steel-APL Apollo $1.67 billion deal, plunging shares
item.description: Tata Steel will buy a 26.4% stake in India's leading structural steel pipes and tubes maker to boost downstream capacity.

item.title: French biotech rejects short seller’s cancer-risk claims after shares plunge 17%
item.description: Short seller Scorpion Capital has accused Abivax of serious scientific and safety shortcomings in its experimental inflammatory bowel disease drug.

item.title: Retirees face a looming deadline for required withdrawals — missing it could trigger a tax penalty
item.description: The busy holiday season may lead retirees to miss a key deadline for retirement account withdrawals.

item.title: International first class is over for U.S. airlines. Enter the mega business-class cabin
item.description: Airlines are opting to build giant business-class cabins with ever-more luxurious suites.

item.title: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages
item.description: Clayton’s warning comes ahead of Thanksgiving travel, after separate outages disrupted air travel, Microsoft 365 and some bank transactions.

item.title: From trash to treasure: Most hated stocks are winning as AI bull market rolls over
item.description: Several stocks that are unpopular on Wall Street, including Clorox, Boston Beer and Campbell's, are poised to be winners as the AI trade loses steam.

item.title: An ‘illusion of glitz and glamour’: Inside California’s modern-day gold rush, where miners can bring in millions
item.description: The price of gold has sparked a modern-day gold rush in California. Small-scale miners are investing time, physical labor and money to unearth the yellow metal.

item.title: Traveling soon? Here’s how to decide whether to fly or drive
item.description: CNBC Select compares driving vs. flying some of the most popular travel routes and what to consider before deciding.

item.title: How Asian countries are looking to prop up markets as AI downturn sinks stocks
item.description: Market regulators in South Korea, China and Taiwan have introduced new measures to support markets.

item.title: Trump says there could be a 'positive spin' from the latest FBI database hack
item.description: This would make the second recent intrusion into the FBI system.

item.title: Forget Anthropic: In Europe, the IPO hype is about a blue lagoon
item.description: Iceland’s famed Blue Lagoon geothermal spa is going public in a $110 million IPO, tapping investor interest in tourism and the booming wellness industry.

item.title: ‘More than just a game’: How GTA VI’s blockbuster launch fuels a booming content economy
item.description: GTA VI’s blockbuster launch is creating a wider economy around livestreams, social clips and high-volume content farms as millions tune in to watch others play.

item.title: The bull market has a new problem. The 'smart money' is selling
item.description: Companies are shifting from share buybacks to stock issuance, adding new supply. Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO puts that demand to the test.

item.title: 26-year-old Google worker earns $323,000 a year—but lives on less than minimum wage
item.description: Charles Broomfield set a post-college goal of reaching $750,000 in investments by age 30. Now 26, he expects to get there within the next year.

item.title: Quantum computing’s first real-world payoff may come in energy, not drug discovery
item.description: Quantum computing firms are testing energy-grid optimization, solar materials and hydrogen catalysts as they pursue practical uses.
